title: Narrow or retract an optimization claim when matched counterevidence breaks its causal chain

source.title: vLLM PR #53680 DeepGEMM regression discussion and correction
source.claim_scope: An open community discussion demonstrates a broad causal claim being narrowed after independent reproduction; it does not settle the remaining entry-point-specific regression or approve a dependency rollback.

implementation_recipe: Decompose the broad claim into independently testable structural, reachability, numerical, performance and end-to-end statements.
Capture the exact failing entry point, tensor identity, data preparation, dependency revision, build flags and local overlays.
Reproduce one boundary at a time on a matched independent environment and register both confirming and contradicting outcomes.
When a counterexample invalidates one causal edge, retract that edge immediately while preserving narrower facts that remain supported.
Recompute the mitigation: prefer a path gate or upstream fix, and retain a broad rollback only if its affected surface is demonstrated.
validation_recipe: Require the original and counterexample runs to name exact source, binary, inputs, entry point and oracle identities.
Check whether a reported non-reproduction exercises the same data format and code path before treating it as contradictory.
Use negative and positive controls to separate producer, dispatcher, consumer kernel and fallback behavior.
Keep unresolved claims explicit and prohibit performance tuning or promotion that depends on a retracted mechanism.
Ensure summaries, titles, recommendation receipts and relation edges use the latest supported scope rather than stale initial prose.
expected_bottleneck_shifts: Search should move from tuning a falsely accused primitive to isolating the first divergent producer-consumer boundary.
Broad rollback cost should shrink to a scoped compatibility gate when only one entry point remains suspect.
Evidence reconciliation can terminate low-value experimentation earlier than another round of parameter tuning.
failure_modes: A non-reproduction uses a different checkpoint format, backend or entry point and is treated as a true counterexample.
A valid structural source difference is promoted into an unsupported numerical or performance cause.
The author corrects a comment but the Agent continues routing from a stale title or PR body.
All claims are discarded after one edge is falsified, losing a narrower reproducible issue.
A broad dependency rollback persists after evidence supports only a path-specific compatibility problem.
scope_limits: Counterevidence narrows only the matched claim dimensions; it does not prove universal correctness.
Community corrections remain discovery evidence until independently reproduced under the target contract.
A temporary rollback may still be operationally rational even when its original causal explanation is wrong.

algorithmic_decomposition.baseline_dependency: A broad optimization or regression claim is a chain from source change through path reachability and data contracts to observed numerical and performance outcomes.
algorithmic_decomposition.partition_axis: individual causal edges and claim dimensions
algorithmic_decomposition.combine_rule: Retain a claim only when every required causal edge is supported; a matched counterexample retracts the broken edge and all broader conclusions depending on it.
algorithmic_decomposition.finalization: Publish the narrowest surviving claim, explicit unresolved edges and a mitigation whose scope does not exceed the evidence.
algorithmic_decomposition.work_complexity: One bounded reproduction per decision-relevant causal edge rather than repeated whole-system tuning.
algorithmic_decomposition.span_complexity: Structural and environment checks can run independently, but causal promotion waits for the complete path.
algorithmic_decomposition.communication_cost: Adds evidence reconciliation and exact identity capture while avoiding unbounded dependency or kernel experiments.
invariants: no surviving conclusion depends on a retracted causal edge
confirming and contradicting evidence remain visible
structural facts are not silently upgraded to runtime causality
mitigation scope does not exceed the narrowest supported failure surface
anti_patterns: trust the PR title after later discussion retracts its mechanism
compare approximate synthetic data with a production-format counterexample
treat a missing source file as proof that a neighboring public entry point fails
continue tuning after the motivating causal claim is falsified

candidate_archetypes.name: exact producer-dispatch-consumer replay
candidate_archetypes.template: Freeze one production tensor and replay it through each causal boundary with exact source and binary identities until the first divergence is localized.

candidate_archetypes.name: counterexample-driven mitigation narrowing
candidate_archetypes.template: Split the broad claim, retract dimensions contradicted by matched evidence, and replace broad rollback with the narrowest supported gate or fix.
